acceptance.check: INV-AVO-AUTH-WEIGHT (authority at H1, severity refuse): weight or performance figure governed by AFM — {value} from a lesser class is not acceptable proof
INV-AVO-WEIGHT-QUALIFIERS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): weight/performance figure missing {missing}
INV-AVO-FUEL-QUALIFIERS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): fuel minimum missing {missing}
INV-AVO-FDP-QUALIFIERS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): FDP/rest figure missing {missing}
INV-AVO-RATE-QUALIFIERS (qualifier at H3, severity flag): rate figure missing {missing} — a rate without station and shift is not actionable
INV-AVO-DELAY-PHASE (qualifier at H3, severity flag): delay cost without phase — gate, taxi and airborne are different numbers
INV-AVO-REGISTRATION (provenance at H3, severity refuse): forbidden derivation: {value}
INV-AVO-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): manual, contract or NOTAM stale on {value}
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-WEIGHT-LIMITS (currency at H3, severity refuse): weight limits are stale once the configuration changed or the AFM was revised
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-PERFORMANCE (currency at H3, severity refuse): performance data is stale once the AFM was revised or the runway changed
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-MEL (currency at H3, severity refuse): an MEL interval is stale once it has expired
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-DUTY (currency at H3, severity refuse): duty limits are stale once the FTL authority or the FTL scheme changed
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-CONTRACT-RATE (currency at H3, severity refuse): a contract rate is stale once the contract has been renewed
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-FUEL-PRICE (currency at H3, severity refuse): a fuel price is stale once the contract or index it is drawn from has moved
INV-AVO-CURRENCY-COMPENSATION (currency at H3, severity refuse): a compensation figure is stale once the regime governing it has changed

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative aviation ops reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 15 invariants declared in app/blocks/aviation_ops/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/aviation_ops/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/aviation_ops/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: Unix time in seconds}; a record with no as_of, or older than its provider's max_age, is reported stale; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: aviation_ops_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
